body:
**Clause:** 2017 §26.2 p.776 / 2023 §26.2.
**Normative:** "A package shall not refer to items defined in the compilation unit scope."
**Probe:** tests/1800_audit/c26/neg/n26_unit_ref.sv (a compilation-unit variable cu initialized to 1, a package whose variable y is initialized from cu, and an empty module).
**Observed** (identical under -g2017 and -g2023): compiles with rc=0 and no diagnostic. The other package negatives are rejected: duplicate and conflicting imports, a later declaration of an imported name, an export of a non-candidate, an export followed by a declaration, an import directly in a class, and a wildcard-imported name later explicitly imported. The net with an implicit continuous assignment in a package is rejected with a syntax error.
**Expected:** a compile error for the reference from the package to the compilation-unit item. Low priority diagnostic gap; decide the enforcement policy with the user, since the reference resolves without error today.

Provenance: build b9441baf (descendant of origin/main 8c95b5cc). Probes on branch m7-1800-audit-c08, tests/1800_audit/c26/neg/. Logs: evidence/ieee1800-audit-c26a-20261019/.
title: [IEEE 1800] §26.2 — a package item that refers to a compilation-unit item is accepted
